title: AnyBlock bundle index — authoring subset
description: One index.json at the bundle root describes the bundle as a whole: what the space is called, what a user lands on, what the sidebar shows. A strict subset of the full index schema (../index.schema.json): every index valid here is valid there. Every other file in the bundle is one object or the property dictionary.

description.description: One line on what the space is for.

icon.description: The space's icon, as an emoji: {"format": "emoji", "emoji": "🌱"}.

entrypoint.description: The declared entry object's bundle-local id, used as the space homepage when `homepage` is absent. Declaring it does not insert or reorder sidebar widgets. Required in this profile.

homepage.description: What opens on entering the space. Takes precedence over `entrypoint`; if absent, use `entrypoint`, then the first widget naming an object. An unresolved explicit id is an error.

widgets.description: Sidebar widgets in their declared order. Navigation fields do not insert or reorder them. A type needs a widget only for fast access to its objects (layout "view").

documentId.description: The bundle-local id of a document in this bundle, the `id` its file declares. The excluded words are the built-in listings' own names; an id claiming one would capture the built-in.

target.description: What the widget points at: the id of a page, type, query or collection in this bundle, or a built-in listing (_favorite, _recent, _recent_open, _set, _collection, _all_objects, _chat, _bin).

layout.description: How it renders: "link" one row (the default), "tree" expands children, "list" and "compact_list" show contents, "view" renders the type's default view.

limit.description: How many entries a listing widget shows. Ignored by "link".

card_style.description: How the widget's row renders; omit for a plain text row. The same choice a link block offers.
